description.message: Send the page you are on to your Archiver, in one click.

notConnected.message: Connect this extension to your Archiver to archive pages in one click.

expired.message: Your connection to Archiver has ended. Connect again.

unsupported.message: This page has no address Archiver can archive.

unreachable.message: Archiver cannot be reached. Check that the server is running.

connectText.message: Log in once with your Archiver account. Your password is not kept: the extension only keeps a key the server gives it, valid for a year.

invalidAddress.message: Enter the address of your Archiver, such as https://archiver.example.com.

permissionRefused.message: Chrome must be allowed to reach this address for the extension to work.

connectedText.message: Connected to $SERVER$. Click the extension's icon on any page to archive it.
